title: Vapouriz Premium Berry Smoothie E-Liquid 10ml
description: Vapouriz 50:50 brings you a light, refreshing e-liquid for your classic or sub ohm kit. This appetising mix of crisp, orchard-fresh green apples and juicy red berries delivers a consistently-delicious vape every single time, with flavour so convincing you’ll swear you just took a bite of a juicy Granny Smith. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Click HERE to browse the collection and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Vape Starter Kit or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options. 50/50 e-liquid is called so because it contains a 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol ratio, which allows for an extremely versatile vaping experience. These liquids can be used in Starter Vape Kits, High powered Sub Ohm Kits and Pod Vape Kits. Check out the full 50/50 vape juice guide HERE
